title: human-notes.json status-vocabulary drift — same family as PROP-093 (attention-inbox). Writers emit `active`, reader filters `pending`, items silently stranded. Reconcile.
context:
Operator-side investigation 2026-06-13T08:30Z surfaced the EXACT structural sibling of the attention-inbox vocabulary issue PROP-093 just fixed, in a different file:

(1) HNOTE-OPERATOR-FABLE-MACRO-REVIEW-FOLLOWUPS-001 (commissioned 2026-06-10T05:50Z) was authored with `status: 'active'`. It sat for 3 days unactioned. Operator initially attributed this to Fable substitution + medium priority and bumped to `priority: 'high'` at 2026-06-13T05:22Z. The priority bump was a no-op for visibility.

(2) Root cause: analyst.md L223 dispatcher quick-check filters on `status === 'pending'`:
```
const p=n.notes?n.notes.filter(x=>x.status==='pending'):[];
```
Mode 5's filter (L312) also requires `status === 'pending'`. Notes authored with `status: 'active'` are STRUCTURALLY INVISIBLE to analyst regardless of priority. The dispatcher cleanly reports 'NO NOTES' — silent strand, same failure mode as the attention-inbox case before PROP-093 C1.

(3) Current vocabulary distribution across 7 live notes (snapshot 2026-06-13T08:30Z):
  - 2 notes: `status: 'consumed'` (resolution state)
  - 1 note: `status: 'consumed-pending-verification'` (PROP-014 Mech 1b WRITE-VERIFY intermediate state)
  - 2 notes: `status: 'active'` (silently stranded — drift)
  - 2 notes: no status field at all (also invisible to the `=== 'pending'` filter)
  - 0 notes: `status: 'pending'` (canonical live state per the analyst filter)

So of 7 notes, 4 (57%) are stranded by the status vocabulary mismatch. Two genuinely needed analyst attention (the Fable-followups + one other 'active' note); the other two missing-status entries may be defensible old format.

(4) Immediate operator fix landed in commit (next): flipped the Fable-followup HNOTE to `status: 'pending'` so tonight's UTC 08:00 analyst run picks it up. The other 'active' and missing-status entries remain stranded pending tinker's structural reconciliation.
task: PROP-093-style reconciliation for monitor/analyst/human-notes.json. Decide on canonical schema, harden reader, normalize writers, drain backlog.
investigation_questions: Q1 — Which writer sites emit `status: 'active'` instead of `status: 'pending'`? Grep across all writer prompts (analyst.md Mode 6 if it self-files? operator-side HNOTE-authoring sessions like cowork-claude's? other agents that write to this file?). Map every site so C2 (writer normalization) is complete.

Q2 — Should the reader filter be widened (`pending || active`) as a back-compat shim, or should the writers be normalized exclusively? PROP-093 C1 chose BOTH (reader widening + writer normalization with eventual back-compat clause drop). Recommend the same here unless evidence argues otherwise.

Q3 — Are the 2 missing-status notes legitimately old format (pre-status convention) or also drift? Decide whether to backfill them with `status: 'pending'` (re-surface for analyst) or `status: 'consumed'` (retire as historical). Operator review needed if the title/body indicates substantive work was meant to happen.

Q4 — Where else does this drift family live? Check monitor/decisions/human-notes.json, monitor/curmudgeon/human-notes.json, monitor/social/human-notes.json — do their reader-side filters also require `status: 'pending'`, and do their notes drift to `'active'`? If yes, the PROP should generalize.

Q5 — Is `consumed-pending-verification` (PROP-014 Mech 1b) a transitional state that should also be visible to a subsequent analyst run (e.g., for verification follow-up), or is it a terminal resolution state? Tinker should reconcile this with PROP-014 Mech 1b's intent before C1 widens the filter and accidentally re-surfaces verified items.
deliverable: A PROP-NNN proposal in monitor/tinker/proposals/ with the same shape as PROP-093: (C1) reader-harden in analyst.md to accept the legitimate vocabulary set + new visibility note; (C2) writer normalization — locate every site emitting `status: 'active'`, change to `'pending'`; (C3) backfill plan for the 2 missing-status and 2 'active' notes currently live; (C4) cross-file check for the same drift in the other 3 human-notes files. Propose-only; operator integrates after review.
constraints: Do NOT mass-flip historical resolved items — only the live-state-confused ones (current 'active' + missing-status). The 'consumed' and 'consumed-pending-verification' resolution states are intentional and must remain.

Honor the other-side: PROP-093's C2 (writer normalization in decider.md) is still pending — that case turned out hard to locate the divergent write site. This directive's C2 may face the same hunt. Set ship-conservative scope (C1 + backfill) as Phase 1; C2 as follow-up if writer site is hard to find.
Do NOT change the analyst.md L223 OR L312 filter semantics without considering interaction with PROP-014 Mech 1b's `consumed-pending-verification` state (Q5).
